name: immich-smart-album
title: Smart Album
description: Filter workflow assets by what they look like, using Immich's own smart search. Immich's built-in filters all match on metadata; this one matches on image content.
author: immich-organizer

methods.name: smartMatchFilter
methods.title: Filter by smart search
methods.description: Continue only when the asset is among the closest smart-search matches for a description, or for a reference photo.

query.title: Description
query.description: What the photo should look like, e.g. 'person in a mountain'. Leave blank if using a reference photo instead.

likeAssetId.title: Reference photo ID
likeAssetId.description: Match against this photo instead of a description. Open the photo in Immich and copy the ID from the URL.

limit.title: Match depth
limit.description: How many of the closest results count as a match. Smart search has no confidence score, so this top-N depth is the precision control. Set it comfortably larger than the album you expect.

inverse.title: Invert
inverse.description: Continue only when the asset does NOT match.

serverUrl.title: Immich URL (internal)
serverUrl.description: How this plugin reaches Immich from inside the server container. Usually the default is correct. Any host you use here must also be listed in allowedHosts in manifest.json.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: An Immich API key, used only to call the smart-search endpoint. Create one under Account Settings -> API Keys and grant it just 'asset.read' -- that is the only permission smart search requires, and filing into the album is done by the next step, not by this key.

explainMisses.title: Diagnose non-matches
explainMisses.description: When an asset does not match, check whether it has been indexed by Smart Search yet and log the reason. Costs one extra request per non-matching asset.

templates.name: smartAlbum
templates.title: Smart album
templates.description: File photos into an album by what they look like. Triggered on tagging, because a freshly uploaded photo has not been indexed by Smart Search yet.
